tests.name: 4905真实2092首次抽1项2106抽2项，逐次项数只加1且无重复，达到6后再用Q001明确回滚

tests.name: 4905真实两版使用时必暴当次攻击生效并维持两回，合法MISS和整招无效都递增一次，控制与药剂不递增

tests.name: 4905真实两版免技能回血按来源，原已授禁疗不封血药和魂印来源回复，当前两回真实有效

tests.assertion: test('4905/1080连续仅加先制1与1155实际20/30/40/40百分比，保1不截断完整伤害，中断技能后恢复20及先制0',()=>{const s=make({move:38399,loadout:[38399,20177,10361,29355,38398]});s.moveDefinitions[key(38399)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(38399)].operations.filter(op=>[0,3].includes(op.index));timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});for(let n=1;n<=4;n++){turn(s,38399,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n>1?1:0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),[1800,2700,3600,3600][n-1]);}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);turn(s,20177,20117);turn(s,38399,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),1800);});

tests.name: 4905/942清回合成功才理论比例吸取，免粉和本体先杀仍回复3000；645严格低于三分之一威力3倍
tests.assertion: test('4905/942清回合成功才理论比例吸取，免粉和本体先杀仍回复3000；645严格低于三分之一威力3倍',()=>{for(const mode of['success','immune','protect','dead']){const s=make({move:38399,index:1,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='dead'?1:9000});if(mode==='protect')timer(s,1,'protect');const original=E.SOULS;if(mode==='immune')E.SOULS={...original,trait(f,k){return f.side===1&&k==='pinkImmune'?true:original.trait(f,k);}};try{turn(s,38399,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=original;}assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune'||mode==='protect'||mode==='dead'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='protect'?1000:4000);}for(const hp of[2999,3000,3001]){const s=make({move:38399,index:2,hp});let power;const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)power=c.power;return out;}};try{turn(s,38399,20117);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(power,hp<3000?480:160);}});
